title: Urdu and Sindhi IX–X — Compulsory Language Skills
description: Supplementary grade-level units with lessons, MCQs, CRQs and ERQs, including Urdu and Sindhi support. Confirm the student's board, group and prescribed textbook before treating any elective as part of an individual syllabus.
curriculumAlignment: Supplementary language course for the Sindh SSC scheme. The official scheme includes Sindhi/Urdu mother-tongue and non-mother-tongue options in Grades IX–X. This package is a skills map, not a textbook chapter reproduction.

lessons.title: 1.1 IX — Urdu reading and comprehension — core concepts
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Read a prose passage for its central idea, supporting details, vocabulary and author's purpose. Use context to infer unfamiliar words and support answers with a phrase or event from the passage.

## Key study task
Define the important terms, explain one relationship and give a relevant local or practical example.

explanations.ur: نثر میں مرکزی خیال، معاون تفصیلات، الفاظ کے مفہوم اور مصنف کے مقصد کو پہچانیں۔ نامانوس الفاظ کا مطلب سیاق سے اخذ کریں اور جواب میں متن کی دلیل دیں۔

lessons.title: 1.2 IX — Urdu reading and comprehension — application and review
lessons.content: Apply the main ideas to a short case or classroom problem. Identify the relevant facts, organise your reasoning and write a concise conclusion. Where data or historical claims are used, explain the source and any limitations.
